Harmonized geospatial data summary

Published

November 11, 2026

Study area

Watershed: Upper Tenderfoot Creek (HUC12 100301030801)
Area: 105.7 km²
Output CRS: EPSG:5070
Grid resolution: 10 m

Terrain and streams

Soils

K-factors are aggregated from SSURGO components and horizons (see the decision log). Both K maps share one color scale. Soil values are uniform within each map unit polygon, so their real spatial detail is the polygon, not the 10 m grid.

Precipitation

Rainfall intensity for the 2-year storm from NOAA Atlas 14 Volume 12 (partial duration series), converted from depth to intensity and resampled from about 800 m to the 10 m grid. Each map has its own color scale; intensity varies only a few percent across the watershed, so the smooth gradients show a small range.

Forest structure

Canopy cover and canopy height from LANDFIRE 2024, resampled from 30 m to the 10 m grid with nearest neighbor. LANDFIRE stores both as classes, so each map shows a small set of values, each representing a range.

Disturbance history

LANDFIRE Annual Disturbance, 1999 to 2025. Each year’s codes are translated with that year’s LANDFIRE attribute table and grouped by type (2_protocol/dist_type_groups.csv). Year maps show the most recent year of each disturbance group; blank areas had no disturbance of that group. LANDFIRE may under-record insect mortality, which develops gradually; see the decision log. LANDFIRE’s own disturbance type and severity labels, with the group and severity class assigned to each, are listed in 4_product/data/disturbance_codes_100301030801.csv.

Roads

National Forest System roads from the USFS road database (EDW), clipped to the watershed. County, state, and private roads are not included. Road length attributes describe whole road segments, not the clipped pieces.

Summarized per cell at 30 m: each group keeps its own most recent year, so a cell with insect mortality that later burned has both an insect year and a fire year; dist_last_severity is the severity of the most recent disturbance of any group; dist_count is the number of years with any disturbance. Every source label with its assigned group and rank is listed in the watershed’s 4_product/data/disturbance_codes_[HUC12].csv. Resampled to common grid with nearest neighbor; masked to watershed; NoData = -9999.
